result.summary: The page is generally polished, but horizontal carousels and the fixed bottom navigation create visible clipping that makes content feel cut off rather than intentionally scrollable.

issues.description: The category chip row is clipped at the right edge, leaving a partially visible next chip with no clear visual affordance that the row can be scrolled horizontally.
issues.suggestion: Add right-side padding and a deliberate carousel affordance, such as a fade gradient, partial-card spacing, or a visible scroll indicator.

issues.description: The third card in the "Fastest near you" row is cut off at the right edge, including its restaurant title and delivery information.
issues.suggestion: Use clearer horizontal-carousel treatment with consistent trailing spacing or provide a visible cue that users can swipe to reveal additional restaurants.

issues.description: The fixed bottom navigation overlaps the next "Popular right now" restaurant card, obscuring a substantial portion of its image while the content scrolls behind it.
issues.suggestion: Reserve bottom content padding equal to the navigation height so list cards remain fully visible above the fixed navigation bar.
